subject: Alpine Linux related fixes (#168)
reason: The change only edits submodules/CMakeLists.txt: it detects Alpine Linux at configure time and patches a type in grpc's vendored re2 header (mutable int32_t -> mutable int) so the module compiles under musl. It is a build/CI fix with no change to any command, reply, index, replication, or persistence behaviour, and on the fuzzer's (non-Alpine) build environment the branch is not even taken, so no runtime scenario can reach it.
